message:
Last winter, I thought I was all set for the big snowstorm. I had my snacks, my cozy blankets, and even a stack of old movies. But when the power went out, I discovered my beloved old-school radio wasn’t working because I hadn’t checked the batteries in... well, let’s just say a long time. 

I spent the evening trying to find some entertainment with my flashlight, only to realize I had no idea where I put the extra batteries! Turns out, preparing for a storm means more than just stocking up on popcorn. 

Lesson learned: it’s the little things that can trip you up. What’s your go-to tip for being ready when Mother Nature decides to throw a party? 🌨️
